description: Search Atlantic's public LightHouse™ documentation, including the API reference (OpenAPI) and the MCP tool reference. Use it for any question about what LightHouse does and how: connectors, agents, approvals, spend limits, evidence, security, deployment, the API, the MCP server and the CLI. Returns up to `limit` passages, best first, each quoted exactly with a deep link (`url`), the docs version and build date; `covered` is false when the documentation does not answer the query. Read only: no answer is generated and nothing is changed.

limit.description: How many passages to return (1 to 8).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: What to look for, in plain words or the exact terms the documentation would use. One topic per call. Examples: "how are approvals enforced", "connect Amazon S3", "POST /api/v1/keys", "hosted MCP OAuth scopes".
query.title: Query

name: search_docs

produced.description: How the result was produced: `quoted` (passages quoted exactly, no model) or `none`.
produced.title: Produced

question.description: The query as recorded, after redaction.
question.title: Question

Source.description: One passage, quoted exactly as published, with where it came from.

date.description: Docs build date, or the item's publication date (YYYY-MM-DD).
date.title: Date

n.description: The passage's number in this result, from 1.
n.title: N

section.description: The heading the passage sits under; empty for the page's opening.
section.title: Section

url.description: Deep link to the passage's page and section. Cite this.
url.title: Url

version.description: Docs release, or the item's published revision (r<n>).
version.title: Version

Source.title: Source

covered.description: Whether the published material answers the query. False: say it is not covered.
covered.title: Covered

note.description: A fixed note, where one applies.
note.title: Note

query.description: The query as searched, after redaction.
query.title: Query

receipt.description: An Ed25519 receipt over the passages, verifiable against https://ask.atlanticagenticlabs.com/.well-known/octy-keys.json; null if unsigned.
receipt.title: Receipt

results.description: The best passages, best first; empty when not covered.
results.title: Results

title: Search the LightHouse documentation
